art_direction: 温和长杏眼配豆沙玫瑰灰虹膜，外侧藏微小弯勾，奶灰底。
composition: optically centered five-feature face, two comparable eyes, two brows, a short mouth; ample negative space
creative_direction: Design a soft, balanced pair of long almond eyes with an almost serene direct gaze. Their upper lids arch gently, the lower lids stay light, and the outer ends narrow into curved points. Let a broad black pupil occupy most of each eye, with a substantial irregular ivory highlight preserving warmth and personality. The small iris crescents should be dusty rose and rose-gray, never saturated red. Hide one tiny comma-shaped curved accent near the outside edge of each iris, using a slightly darker version of the same rose color. These accents are quiet decorative traces; the original-looking painted eye and its expression remain the first thing the viewer notices. Do not create complete circular emblems or place any symbol inside the pupil. Two soft gray brows echo the lids without forming a frown. A short, straight mouth sits underneath, gently connecting the face. Keep the background milk-gray and spacious. Aim for restrained mystery with a pleasant, composed character, avoiding any supernatural glow or ominous stare.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed contact sheet inspected for appealing coordinated eye shapes and gaze, large dark pupils and ivory highlights, centered composition, quiet pale background, restrained matte palette, no head or extra features, no text or watermark
